description: Watches the client's Google Drive folders and brings down the new video and audio into the workspace: Drive as the agent's inbox
client_copy: Revisa tus carpetas de Drive y trae los videos y audios nuevos para trabajarlos.
_comment: THE FRONT DOOR, AND IT WAS UNREACHABLE UNTIL 2026-08-30. There was no way
for any agent to get this plugin: `purchased.json` takes capability ids, no
row installed it, `system` is false, so `tools/plugin_set.py` gave its FOLDER
to nobody -- and the manifest said so out loud instead of fixing it. The
first client who needed Drive as the inbox never got the plugin and the flow
it was meant to feed never fired once (docs/east-requirements.md, Rank 8).
A plugin no row sells is a plugin that does not exist. The row is
`drive-inbox` in capabilities/catalog.json, `level: menu`, group
`information`.
IT DEPENDS ON THE google-workspace CONNECTION AND ON NOTHING ELSE. `watch.py`
reads `/opt/data/google_token.json` -- the exact file that connection's
`detects.files` names -- and the SKILL.md sends the client to the tab instead
of authenticating on its own: <<Si dice que falta la conexion, el cliente tiene
que conectar Google (pestana Conexiones) -- no intentes autenticarte vos>>. A
plugin declares the connection; it never owns the credential. That handshake
is the client's half and it is the half that failed: `who: assisted` on the
row, and a step in docs/client-onboarding.md, exist because of it.
NO PLUGIN DEPENDENCY. <<El caso tipico: `transcribe` el archivo>> is what
usually comes next, and the SKILL.md says so in the same breath as <<Lo que
sigue depende del flujo del cliente>>. Downloading is done when the files are
down.
